Her submission is taken on record.
VEDPRAKASH 2.
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section DEWANGAN 483 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 125/2024 registered at Police Station Gandhinagar, District Surguja,
Chhattisgarh for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 & 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: The applicant has been arrested on 02.05.2024 and after the investigation, charges sheet has been filed before the Trial Court.
It is alleged in the case that the applicant has allured the minor prosecutrix, kidnapped her and committed rape upon her.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that there is no legally admissible evidence with respect to the age of the prosecutrix that she was minor on the date of incident and she being the major girl having love affair with the applicant and eloped with him on her own free will.
She resided with the applicant for about 2 months and had not raised any objection and has not made any complaint to anyone.
The prosecutrix has been examined before the Learned Trial Court as PW-2 and has not supported the prosecution's case and turned hostile.
The applicant is in jail since 02.05.2024 and final adjudication of the case will take its own time.
Therefore, he may be enlarged on bail.

5. On the other hand, the counsel for the State opposes and has submitted that from the evidence collected during the investigation, the prosecutrix is minor and she was subjected to kidnap and rape by the applicant and therefore, he is not entitled for bail.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents annexed with the application.

7. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, considering the nature of the allegation and the material collected during the investigation, further the age of the prosecutrix and also the fact that she has been examined before the Learned Trial Court as PW-2 and has not supported the prosecution's case.

The applicant is in jail since 02.05.2024 and final conclusion of the trial will take its own time, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
8.
Consequently, this application filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail is hereby allowed.

9. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court,
on following conditions:-
(i) He shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such fact to the Court.
(ii) He shall not act in any manner which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial.
(iii) He shall appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to him by the concerned trial Court till disposal of the trial.
